Vendored browser modules for local Markdown and math rendering.

Versions, npm source archives and SHA-512 checksums are pinned in manifest.json.
Upstream licenses are stored alongside each module. No runtime CDN requests.

- Marked: https://github.com/markedjs/marked
- DOMPurify: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify
- KaTeX: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX
